prompt: 我订阅了智谱的 GLM Coding Plan（Pro 套餐），想在自己的 Python 脚本里用 openai SDK 调 glm-5.3 帮我批量给一批 Python 文件写 docstring。帮我写这个脚本，API Key 从环境变量读。
assertions: base_url is https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/coding/paas/v4 (with or without trailing slash), NOT the standard https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4

api_key is read from an environment variable and the response/comments make clear it must be the Coding Plan key (from bigmodel.cn/coding-plan), not the standard platform API key from usercenter/proj-mgmt/apikeys
model is glm-5.3 (or glm-5.3-flash), a model that the Coding Plan actually includes
The response warns that using the standard /api/paas/v4 endpoint with a Coding Plan key fails with error 1113 余额不足, or equivalently that the two billing systems / keys are not interchangeable

The response mentions that the Coding Plan is officially restricted to designated coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode, Kilo Code, etc.) and that a custom script is outside that scope / production use should use the standard API
Script is syntactically valid Python that iterates files, calls chat.completions.create, and writes results
